Departments/Schools
Department of Civil Engineering
Since 1911, the Department of Civil Engineering has been a cornerstone of Hong Kong’s development, nurturing leaders who have shaped the city’s iconic infrastructure. Our expertise spans across construction management, environmental, geotechnical, structural & transportation engineering, driving sustainable and resilient construction locally and beyond.
Wei Pan 潘巍
Head, Department of Civil Engineering
Professor in Construction Engineering and Management
Executive Director of Centre for Innovation in Construction and Infrastructure Development
BSc (Eng) Hunan; MSc Loughborough, PhD Loughborough; CEnv; MCIOB; FHEA; MHKIE; PgCert; FICE; MASCE
Email: wpan@hku.hk
Department website Academic Staff Teaching & Learning Career Opportunities
School of Computing and Data Science
The School of Computing and Data Science (CDS) advances education and research in computing, data science, artificial intelligence, statistical decision sciences, fintech, and actuarial science. It plays a transformative role across industries and nurtures the next generation of leaders for the digital age.
Yi Ma 馬毅
Director, School of Computing and Data Science
Director & Chair Professor of Artificial Intelligence, HKU Musketeers Foundation Institute of Data Science
BEng Tsinghua; MEng Berkeley; MA Berkeley; PhD Berkeley; FIEEE; FACM; FSIAM
Email: mayi@hku.hk
School website Academic Staff Teaching & Learning Career Opportunities
Department of Data and Systems Engineering
The Department of Data and Systems Engineering (DASE) has been at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies, driving progress in Hong Kong through advancements in artificial intelligence. Its core specializations include data analytics and computing, robotics and intelligent systems, and human-machine collaboration.
Ning Xi 席寧
Head, Department of Data and Systems Engineering
Chair Professor of Robotics and Automation
Director of Advanced Technologies Institute, HKU
DSc Washington; FIEEE
Email: xining@hku.hk
Department website Academic Staff Teaching & Learning Career Opportunities
Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
Established in 1960, the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) has played a vital role in Hong Kong’s growth and well‑being. Areas of expertise include power systems, electronics, computing, and information processing, shaping technologies that power modern life.
Kaibin Huang 黃凱斌
Head, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
Professor
BEng NUS; MEng NUS; PhD UT Austin; FIEEE
Email: head@eee.hku.hk
Department website Academic Staff Teaching & Learning Career Opportunities
School of Innovation
Established in 2024, the School of Innovation, HKU (I-School) nurtures curious minds into capable innovators through human-centred, project-led and AI-enabled learning. Situated in real-world ecosystems, it empowers students to move beyond the classroom and tackle complex, interdisciplinary challenges that matter to a rapidly changing world.
So Hayden Kwok Hay 蘇國希
Director, School of Innovation
Associate Professor
Co-director of Joint Lab on Future Cities (JLFC); PI of Computer Architecture and System Research Lab (CASR); B.S., M.S., Ph.D. UC Berkeley
Email: skhay@hku.hk
School website Academic Staff Teaching & Learning Career Opportunities
Department of Materials and Energy
Established in 2026, the Department of Materials and Energy advances education, research, and innovation at the forefront of materials science and engineering, energy technologies, and advanced manufacturing. Through interdisciplinary curricula, globally recognized scholarship, and strong industry partnerships, the Department tackles critical challenges in AI-driven materials development, sustainable energy, high-value production, and technological transformation. By bridging fundamental science with engineering applications, the Department equips students and researchers with the knowledge and capabilities to create impactful solutions that foster sustainability, technological progress, and economic prosperity in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area, and beyond.
Zhi, Chunyi 支春義
Head, Department of Materials and Energy (Interim)
Chair Professor of Energy Materials
BSc Shandong University; PhD Chinese Academy of Sciences
Email: msedept@hku.hk
Department website Academic Staff Teaching & Learning
Department of Mechanical Engineering
Mechanical Engineering is one of the important engineering disciplines in Hong Kong covering different areas such as electrical and mechanical services, building services and public utility services. Over the years, Mechanical Engineering graduates have been making important contributions to the industry and infrastructural development of Hong Kong. A number of its distinguished alumni became senior officials in government and famous leaders in industry, as well as academia. The Department conducts cutting edge research and innovative teaching in many important fields including aeronautical engineering, biomedical engineering, control & robotic, energy & environment, mechanics & materials, nanotechnology, product design & manufacture as well as thermo-fluids. It offers a BEng programme in mechanical engineering with various focuses, as well as Master and PhD programmes.
Mingxin Huang 黃明欣
Head, Department of Mechanical Engineering
Chair Professor of Materials Technology
BEng SJTU; MSc SJTU; PhD TU Delft; FIMMM
Email: mxhuang@hku.hk
Department website Academic Staff Teaching & Learning Career Opportunities
School of Biomedical Engineering
The School of Biomedical Engineering (SBME) was founded in March 2025 and represents a unique collaboration between the Faculties of Medicine, Engineering, Dentistry and Sciences at the University of Hong Kong. SBME is a trailblazer in redefining BME education and research — empowering the next generation to transform healthcare by linking engineering, life sciences, and clinical translation.
Kevin K.M. Tsia 謝堅文
Programme Director, School of Biomedical Engineering
Professor
BEng; MPhil; PhD UCLA; SMSPIE
Email: tsia@eee.hku.hk
